description.en: Channels, auditors and flows are configured on their tabs of this page; a flow bound to a group (or the default group 0) decides what is moderated.
description.zh: 渠道、审核器和流程在本页对应的标签里配置；绑定到分组（或默认分组 0）的流程决定审核哪些请求。

ui:help.en: Observe by default: requests pass at once and are moderated in the background; only users on the watch list at the enforce level and blocklisted users are moderated first. Enforce by default: users without a watch entry are moderated first too; a watch entry's own level wins, so users at the observe level are only moderated in the background.
ui:help.zh: 默认观察：请求直接放行、后台审核；只有观察名单里拦截级的用户和黑名单用户先审后发。默认拦截：没有名单条目的用户也先审后发；名单条目自己的级别优先，观察级的用户只后台审核。

ui:details.en: A hit refuses the request only when it was moderated before the upstream call. A stage that fails is skipped and the hits before it are kept; when no stage reaches a verdict the request passes. Users added to the watch list automatically join at the default level.
ui:details.zh: 只有先审后发的请求命中时才会被拒绝。某一级审核出错时跳过这一级、保留前面的命中；所有级都没有结论时放行。自动加入观察名单的用户以默认级别加入。

ui:help.en: These users are only moderated after their requests were sent on and are never refused; they still get records and may enter the watch list. They cannot be set to the enforce level by hand and the AI never upgrades them. A user who is also on the blocklist is treated as blocklisted.
ui:help.zh: 这些用户只在请求放行后审核，永不被拦截；仍会留下记录、可能进入观察名单。不能手动设为拦截级，AI 也不会把他们升级。同时在黑名单里的用户按黑名单处理。

ui:details.en: Allowlisted users are never banned either. Moderators (users with moderation:read) are recognised automatically and are never put on the watch list.
ui:details.zh: 白名单用户也不会被封禁。持有 moderation:read 的版主会被自动识别，不会进观察名单。

ui:help.en: Every request of these users is moderated before it is sent on and refused on a hit. The AI never downgrades them or takes them off the watch list. This is not a ban: bans are on the Bans tab.
ui:help.zh: 这些用户的每个请求都先审后发，命中即拒绝。AI 不会把他们降级或移出名单。这不是封禁：封禁在“封禁”页。

description.en: What a refused request gets back, in the error format of its API.
description.zh: 请求被拒绝时返回的内容，按请求所用 API 的错误格式返回。

ui:help.en: 403 by default; 400 or 451 are common alternatives.
Returned to the client when a request is refused (code moderation_blocked).
ui:help.zh: 请求被拒绝时返回给客户端的错误信息（错误码 moderation_blocked）。

ui:help.en: The first suspicious record adds the user at the default level.
ui:help.zh: 首次出现可疑记录时，以默认级别加入名单。

ui:help.en: Each new violation at the observe level extends it.
ui:help.zh: 观察级每次违规都会顺延。

ui:title.zh: 每多少次违规自动分析一次

ui:help.en: Violations of an observe-level user (one per request) that queue an AI analysis; the count then restarts. With enforce as the default level, enforce-level users count too. 0 = only manual analyses.
ui:help.zh: 观察级用户每累计这么多次违规（同一请求只计一次）就自动排队分析一次，然后重新计数。默认级别为拦截时，拦截级用户也计数。0 表示只手动分析。

ui:help.en: Suspicious requests within the window that ban a user (false positives excluded). 0 disables automatic bans.
ui:help.zh: 窗口内达到该次数的可疑请求即自动封禁用户（不含误报）。0 表示不自动封禁。

ui:help.en: 0 bans until an administrator unblocks the user.
ui:help.zh: 0 表示直到管理员手动解封。

ui:help.en: An llm channel (any protocol) of the Channels tab; none = no AI analysis.
ui:help.zh: 只能选「渠道」页的大模型渠道（三种协议都可以）；不使用则不做 AI 分析。

ui:help.en: Hits are always recorded.
ui:help.zh: 命中始终记录。

ui:help.en: Keep the moderated text, and the raw messages of the chunk the verdict came from when a stage hit. They may contain user data; error records keep only the start (see Text kept on error records).
ui:help.zh: 保存被审核的文本，以及有级命中时判定那一块的原始消息，可能包含用户数据；出错记录只保存开头（见“出错记录保存字数”）。

ui:details.en: Whatever is moderated is also sent to the moderation channels (and the AI analysis channel reads the stored text): choose channels whose data handling you accept.
ui:details.zh: 被审核的内容会发送给审核渠道（AI 分析渠道还会读取保存的原文），请选择数据处理方式可以接受的渠道。

ui:title.en: Raw messages of passed records too
ui:title.zh: 通过的记录也保存原始消息

ui:help.en: With Store moderated text on, passed and overturned records also keep the raw messages (images included) of the chunk the verdict came from, for later review; off, only records with a stage hit keep them. Error records never keep raw messages.
ui:help.zh: 保存原文开着时，通过和被推翻的记录也保存判定那一块的原始消息（含图片），便于事后复核；关闭后只有命中过的记录保存。出错的记录不保存原始消息。

ui:help.en: Concurrent auditor calls on each node; also the number of background workers.
ui:help.zh: 每个节点同时进行的审核调用数，也是后台审核的工作协程数。

description.en: Per node. The defaults suit most deployments.
description.zh: 按节点计算，默认值适合大多数部署。

ui:help.en: Requests waiting for background moderation on each node.
ui:help.zh: 每个节点等待后台审核的请求数上限。

ui:details.en: When the queue is full, new requests are not moderated and are counted as dropped.
ui:details.zh: 队列满了之后新请求不再审核，并计入丢弃数。

ui:help.en: An upstream call that has not answered (headers, or the first model output of a stream) in this time fails with ttft_timeout. A non-streaming LLM call gets its answer all at once, so only the channel timeout applies to it.
ui:help.zh: 上游调用在这段时间内没有响应（收到响应头，流式调用为第一个模型输出）就按 ttft_timeout 失败。非流式的 LLM 调用一次性收到全部回答，只受渠道超时限制。

ui:details.en: Applies to the OpenAI moderation and Jev auditor calls and to every AI analysis step (streamed), together with the channel's total timeout; whichever fires first ends the call. LLM verdict auditors are not streamed and only have the channel timeout.
ui:details.zh: 对 OpenAI 审核和 Jev 审核器的调用以及 AI 分析的每一步（流式）生效，与渠道的总超时同时计时，先到者结束调用。LLM 判定审核器不走流式，只受渠道超时限制。

ui:help.en: Verdicts on content already moderated under the same flow are kept this many days: content that passed is not sent again, and a hit is applied again as it was (a request moderated first is refused) without calling the moderation channels.
ui:help.zh: 同一流程下已经审过的内容，结论保留这么多天：放行的不再送审，命中的直接按原结论处理（先审的请求被拒绝），不再调用审核渠道。

ui:details.en: Runs with errors, passes with a skipped stage and URL images are not cached. Changing a flow's stages, auditors, question sets, thresholds or channel models invalidates that flow's cache. A replayed cached hit is recorded as usual but is not a new violation.
ui:details.zh: 出错的运行、整级被跳过的放行、URL 图片不缓存。修改流程的级、审核器、题集、阈值或渠道模型后，该流程的缓存自动失效。缓存命中的重放照常写记录，但不算新的违规。

ui:help.en: How many cached verdicts (passes and hits) each node keeps in memory; the shared store holds them all for the days above.
ui:help.zh: 每个节点在内存里保留多少条判定缓存（放行和命中都算）；共享存储按上面的天数保留全部。

ui:help.en: Everything the client sends (messages of every role, system prompt, tool calls and results, documents) is moderated. Whitespace is collapsed and longer content is moderated in chunks of this length.
ui:help.zh: 客户端发送的全部内容（各角色的消息、系统提示词、工具调用与结果、文档）都会审核。压缩空白后，超过这个长度的内容按这个长度分块审核。

ui:title.zh: 每个请求最多审核块数

ui:help.en: Content with a cached verdict is not sent again (verdict cache: passes and hits, kept per flow for as long as its judging configuration - stages, auditors, question sets, thresholds, channel models - stays the same); only the rest is chunked. Each chunk is one run of the flow, with its own upstream calls.
ui:help.zh: 已有缓存结论的内容不会再次送审（判定缓存：放行和命中都缓存，按流程保存，流程的判定配置——级、审核器、题集、阈值、渠道模型——不变就一直有效），只有其余内容参与分块。每块各执行一次流程，各自产生上游调用。

ui:help.en: Sample: the first, the last and evenly spread chunks are moderated. Refuse: requests moderated before the upstream call are refused (background moderation still samples).
ui:help.zh: 抽样审核：审核第一块、最后一块和均匀分布的中间块。直接拒绝：先审后发的请求直接拒绝（后台审核仍按抽样）。

ui:title.zh: 每个请求最多审核图片数

ui:help.en: Images beyond this number (or larger than 16 MiB) are not moderated; 0 moderates no images.
ui:help.zh: 超过这个数量（或大于 16 MiB）的图片不审核；0 表示不审核图片。

ui:help.en: When the hook requests being processed hold more than this, new requests are answered at once. Requests that would be moderated before they are sent on get 503 moderation_busy: with mode enforce that is every user who is neither on the allowlist nor on the watch list at the observe level, with mode observe only blocklisted users and enforce-level watch entries. All other requests pass unmoderated. Requests no flow moderates (no flow for the group, or a model the flow's filter leaves out) are never refused.
ui:help.zh: 正在处理的钩子请求合计超过这个大小时，新请求立即返回。本应先审后放的请求返回 503 moderation_busy：模式为拦截时，是白名单和观察级名单之外的所有用户；模式为观察时，只有黑名单用户和拦截级名单用户。其余请求不审核直接放行。没有流程会审核的请求（分组没有流程，或模型被流程的模型过滤排除）不会被拒绝。

ui:help.en: Error records (a channel failed) keep only the start of the moderated text; 0 keeps none.
ui:help.zh: 出错记录（渠道故障等）只保存被审核文本的开头这么多字；0 表示不保存。

description.en: How much of each request is moderated.
description.zh: 每个请求审核多少内容。

ui:help.en: Text shorter than this (ignoring whitespace) and without images is not moderated.
ui:help.zh: 去掉空白后短于该字数且没有图片的输入不审核。

ui:help.en: Used by Jev auditors without their own table. Empty = the built-in Chinese set.
ui:help.zh: 没有自己题集的 Jev 审核器使用它。留空使用内置中文题集。

ui:help.en: OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
ui:help.zh: OpenAI 兼容接口地址。

ui:details.zh: 以 /v1 结尾时拼接 /chat/completions，否则拼接 /v1/chat/completions。

title.zh: 0.1 旧版配置（已转换，不显示）

description.en: On the first start of 0.2 they were turned into a channel, an LLM auditor and a flow. They stay in the stored settings as they are; the settings page sends them back unchanged and only offers to clear a stored 0.1 API key.
description.zh: 0.2 首次启动时已转换成渠道、LLM 审核器和流程。它们原样留在已保存的设置里；设置页保存时原样回传，只提供清除仍保存着的 0.1 API Key。

ui:help.en: The 0.1 key, only used by the one-time conversion on the first 0.2 start (it is now the channel's key). Clear it: while it is stored, users who only hold moderation:manage must re-enter it to change any setting.
ui:help.zh: 0.1 的密钥，只在 0.2 首次启动的一次性转换中使用（已成为渠道的密钥）。请清空：仍保存着它时，只持有 moderation:manage 的用户修改任何设置都必须重填它。

ui:help.en: Must support tool calling (function calling).
ui:help.zh: 需要支持工具调用（function calling）。

ui:help.en: Leave empty to use the built-in prompt.
ui:help.zh: 留空使用内置提示词。

ui:details.en: {{categories}} in the prompt is replaced by the category list, one "- id: description" per line.
ui:details.zh: 提示词中的 {{categories}} 会替换为分类列表（每行一个“- id：说明”）。

ui:help.en: Leave empty to use the 12 built-in categories. The model can only choose from these ids.
ui:help.zh: 留空使用内置的 12 个分类。模型只能从这些分类 id 中选择。

ui:help.en: Lowercase letters, digits and _ (at most 32).
ui:help.zh: 小写字母、数字和下划线，最多 32 个字符。

ui:placeholder.zh: 违法犯罪：毒品、武器、诈骗等

ui:help.en: No longer used: a stage that fails is skipped and the hits before it are kept; when no stage reaches a verdict the request passes.
ui:help.zh: 已不再生效：某一级审核出错时跳过这一级、保留前面的命中；所有级都没有结论时放行。

ui:help.en: Share of requests moderated, chosen deterministically by text.
ui:help.zh: 按文本确定性抽样的审核比例。

ui:help.en: Only moderate requests of these groups; empty means all groups.
ui:help.zh: 只审核这些分组的请求，留空表示全部分组。

ui:help.en: Only moderate requests for matching client models (* and ? wildcards); empty means all.
ui:help.zh: 只审核匹配的客户端模型（支持 * 和 ? 通配），留空表示全部。

ui:title.en: Let the AI upgrade to enforce
ui:title.zh: 允许 AI 升为拦截级

ui:help.en: Block + persistent / escalating trend + at least one violation. Off: only written to the history.
ui:help.zh: 建议拦截、趋势为持续或越来越重、且至少 1 条复核为违规时。关闭后只记入名单历史，级别不变。

ui:title.en: Let the AI downgrade to observe
ui:title.zh: 允许 AI 降为观察级
允许 AI 移出名单

ui:help.en: Off by default: the analysed records are user text and can try to talk the AI into a release. Even when on, a release only removes observe-level users without high-severity records in the watch window; enforce-level users are only downgraded.
ui:help.zh: 默认关闭：被分析的记录是用户原文，可能诱导 AI 给出解除建议。即使打开，也只移出观察窗口内没有高危记录的观察级用户；拦截级用户只会降为观察级。

ui:help.en: Earlier tool results are dropped above it.
ui:help.zh: 超出时丢掉较早的工具结果。

ui:title.zh: 每个用户保留的分析数

ui:help.en: Empty uses the built-in guidelines (preview on the Watch list tab).
ui:help.zh: 留空使用内置准则（可在「观察名单」页预览完整提示词）。

description.en: Notices go to the webhook as JSON (POST). They never include the moderated text.
description.zh: 通知以 JSON（POST）发到 webhook，不含被审核的原文。

ui:help.en: A flow, auditor or channel whose last-hour error rate is above this (with at least 20 samples) is flagged in the overview, and a flow crossing it sends one notice. A stage that fails is passed over: a hit of an earlier stage stands, and the request passes only when no stage judged at all.
ui:help.zh: 近 1 小时异常率超过该值（且样本不少于 20）的流程、审核器、渠道在概览中标红；流程越过阈值时发一次通知。出错的级会被跳过：前面级的命中仍然有效，只有没有任何一级给出判定时请求才放行。

ui:help.en: Receives flow error-rate alerts and automatic watch list changes made by the AI analysis. Empty: no notices.
ui:help.zh: 接收流程异常率告警，以及 AI 分析自动调整观察名单的通知。留空则不发送。

ui:help.en: When set, each notice carries X-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret, body).
ui:help.zh: 填写后每条通知带 X-Signature: sha256=HMAC(密钥, 请求体)。

ui:help.en: Hourly statistics, per-user daily counts and moderation costs older than this are deleted by the daily cleanup.
ui:help.zh: 每日清理时删除超过该天数的小时统计、用户每日计数和审核费用。

ui:help.en: Retired in 0.8.0: read as the allowlist until Allowlist is saved. These users are no longer left unmoderated.
ui:help.zh: 0.8.0 起停用：在保存“白名单”之前按白名单读取。这些用户不再是完全不审核。

ui:help.en: Retired in 0.8.0: only read until Verdict cache is saved (0 keeps the cache off, anything else is rounded up to whole days).
ui:help.zh: 0.8.0 起停用：在保存“判定缓存天数”之前读取（0 表示不缓存，其余向上取整为天）。
